title: Izamuka ry'Inzozi
intro: Roho yari yaragenewe gukomera, ariko yageragejwe n'ibigeragezo bikomeye, yatangiye urugendo rudasanzwe. Inzira y'uyu muntu yaranzwe n'ishyari, gutandukana n'abandi, ndetse no kubabazwa mu buryo butari bwo, ariko amaherezo ahabwa inshingano zikomeye no kongera guhura mu buryo bukomeye. Ese ushobora kumenya uyu muntu utangaje muri Korowani?
clues: Nari nigeze kugirirwa ishyari n'abantu ba hafi yanjye, bituma ntabana n'umubyeyi wanjye n'urugo rwanjye.
Nahuye n'ingorane zikomeye, harimo no kugurishwa ku giciro gito n'abagenzi.
Nashinjwe icyaha nta shingiro, maze mara imyaka myinshi muri gereza, ariko ukwizera kwanjye kwakomeje kujegajega.
Nahawe ubushobozi budasanzwe bwo gusobanura icyerekezo kigoye, cyabaye ingirakamaro mu nzira yanjye igana ku mudendezo.
Ubwenge bwanjye n'ubunyangamugayo bwanjye byaje gutuma ngera ku mwanya w'ubuyobozi bukomeye n'icyizere mu gihugu cy'amahanga.
Mu bihe bitandukanye, nasubiye kubonana n'umubyeyi wanjye ugeze mu za bukuru n'abavandimwe banjye nyuma y'igihe kirekire kandi kibabaje cyo kuburana.

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِأَبِيهِ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى رَأَيْتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَبًۭا وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ رَأَيْتُهُمْ لِى سَـٰجِدِينَ
verse: [Of these stories mention] when Joseph said to his father, "O my father, indeed I have seen [in a dream] eleven stars and the sun and the moon; I saw them prostrating to me." (12:4)
